chunks: The mother of Moses was perturbed in the morning. Had We not strengthened her heart to remain a believer she had almost given him away.

key_terms.فُؤَادُ: Heart or inner core of emotion

ai.seo_question: What does it mean that God strengthened the heart of Moses' mother?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the phrase 'رَبَطْنَا عَلَىٰ قَلْبِهَا' (We strengthened her heart) is interpreted not merely as emotional calmness, but as the divine fixation of her heart upon the certainty of God's promise, preventing the distraction of maternal anxiety. This moment highlights the transition from human vulnerability to spiritual steadfastness, illustrating how divine support enables believers to remain among the 'Mu'minun' (the faithful) even in trials of separation.
